name: territory-walk
description: Territory Walk - Real-time GPS territory walking game with Leaflet & Supabase
author: お絵描き楽しも委員会（しょうだい）

scripts.cap:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-ios.js && node scripts/setup-ios-assets.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.js && node scripts/setup-ios-assets.js
scripts.ios:setup: npm run assets:generate && npm run build && npx cap add ios && node scripts/configure-ios.js && node scripts/setup-ios-assets.js && npx cap open ios
